title: Shu Hu 胡书
content: I am a PhD student in the Department of Microbiology, School of Life Sciences, Fudan University, with an expected graduation date of June 2029. My research interests span viral evolution, genomic epidemiology and computational approaches to emerging infectious diseases. I combine research experience at the University of Hong Kong with industry experience in bioinformatics, including transcriptomics, single-cell analysis and genomic data analysis workflows.
summary: 我现为复旦大学生命科学学院微生物系博士研究生，预计于2029年6月毕业。研究兴趣包括病毒进化、基因组流行病学，以及新发传染病研究中的计算方法。此前在香港大学从事科研工作，并在生物技术企业积累了转录组、单细胞分析和基因组数据分析流程开发经验。
